decision: Define the joint x+z objectives with squared Euclidean norms and positive weights; do not introduce per-coordinate MSE normalization into the theoretical manuscript definition.
rule: Stage 0: one-step x error plus one-step complete-z error against the true future measured-window encoding.
Stage 1: weighted finite-horizon x rollout error plus weighted finite-horizon complete-z rollout error against true future measured-window encodings.
Use positive weights (equivalently fix the x weight and use a positive z relative weight); numerical normalization is an implementation detail, not a separate theoretical claim.
Keep z^E as the fixed reference target for the z-loss term; the target branch is not optimized by that term.
Do not explain x/z overlap weighting in the manuscript.
boundary: A3 remains an independent uniform residual assumption.
No stability, observability, generalization, or closed-loop guarantee is added.
